title: Evaluation after pairing children
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $b$ be either true or false, let $x$ be an assignment to the $n$ Boolean variables, and let $cs$ be a finite list of circuits. Replacing consecutive pairs of children by gates of type $b$, leaving a final unpaired child unchanged when the list has odd length, preserves the value of the gate of type $b$ applied to the list.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative integer number of variables
